_comment: Per-map input for tools/poptracker_add_map.py. Everything else (pins, rules, grids) comes from data/.
pop    = the map's name inside the pack (its tab, maps.json entry and image file name).
source = the bare map image, in the same coordinate system import_drawn_regions.KNOWN converts
that map's regions into. gps_span = the GPS range it covers edge to edge (default [0, 100]).
It must be right: region pins and the drawer both rely on it.
The canvas calibration is derived from that, so there is no second patcher pass.
artifact_caves / artifact_positions = optional: pin artifacts ON the map at their cave (one pin
per cave). Without them artifacts sit in the sidebar grid. Positions must come from a
real source (say which in _source) - never estimated.
Hand-written rule overrides live in poptracker_logic.json; Ragnarok's caves/positions are there.

_base_tabs._comment: The base pack's own map tabs, by the apworld's `maps` option name (slot_data['maps']). On connect only the slot's maps' tabs are shown.

ragnarok._note: KNOWN ragnarok is true compass (wiki setplayerpos for Hunter/Brute/Devourer/Cunning converts to the wiki's lat/lon within 0.3 deg, 2026-10-29). The IMAGE does NOT span 0-100: it covers GPS 10-90 (2026-11-04). Four in-game /dumppos points (Blue/Green/Red Obelisk, Olga Beach) against regions drawn on this image fit a pure 0.80 scale on both axes, and only 10-90 puts Olga Beach on the beach and Red Obelisk on the east-coast outcrop. The 10-29 'artifacts plot onto their caves' check could not tell the two apart. Pit of Dreen (lon 2.3) lies just off the image and is held on its west edge. Caves/positions live in poptracker_logic.json.

center._note: Image checked 2026-10-29: wiki spawn points follow the coastlines and the artifacts plot onto their caves (lava ones on the volcano island, ice ones in the snow). Hunter's setplayerpos converts through KNOWN center to 16.78/54.32 vs the wiki's 16.8/54.3.

artifact_positions._source: ark.wiki.gg/wiki/Artifact_of_the_<Name>, Map Location table, The Center column: the red ARTIFACT marker (not the entrance). Fetched 2026-10-29.

valguero._note: Image checked 2026-10-29: wiki spawn points hug the lake shores and the artifacts plot onto their caves (Snow Mountains and Great Trench in the snow, Jungle in the jungle).

artifact_positions._source: ark.wiki.gg/wiki/Artifact_of_the_<Name>, Map Location table, Valguero column: the red ARTIFACT marker (not the entrance). Fetched 2026-10-29.
